_meta.purpose: Human copy for every error/edge state named in plan/02_TECH.md §12. Ten states, exhaustive — do not add an eleventh without updating that spec first.
tone_rules: Short, warm, direct, second person. 'Waiting for two proficient listeners.' Not 'Your submission has been queued for validation.'
Never say data, corpus, annotation, task, or submission in player-facing copy. Say voice, clip, round, your turn.
Never lie about money. 'Sent for payment' is not 'Paid.'
_meta.status: English is the reviewed base language. isiZulu is a Sbu/Codex draft awaiting Sbu's final first-language approval. Setswana (Lethabo) remains null pending first-language authorship. Do not treat either language as a literal translation task.
_meta.shape: Each state has: title (one line, fits a small screen), body (one or two sentences, explains what happened and what happens next), action (the single button label — never more than one primary action on an error screen), and retryable (bool — whether the action label is a retry or a dismissal).

en.title: We can't hear you
en.body: Your browser needs microphone access to record a round. Check your browser's site settings and allow the microphone, then come back here.

zu.title: Asikuzwa
zu.body: Isiphequluli sakho sidinga imvume yokusebenzisa imakrofoni ukuze uqophe umzuliswano. Vula izilungiselelo zesayithi, uvumele imakrofoni, bese ubuya lapha.

en.title: This browser can't record
en.body: Recording needs a feature this browser doesn't have. Chrome and Safari on a phone both work.

zu.title: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukuqopha
zu.body: Ukuqopha kudinga into lesi siphequluli esingenayo. I-Chrome ne-Safari ocingweni ziyasebenza.

en.title: That didn't send
en.body: Your clip was not sent. Check your connection, then try again while you are online.

zu.title: Akuthunyelwanga
zu.body: Isiqeshana sakho asithunyelwanga. Hlola uxhumano lwakho, bese uzama futhi uma uxhumekile ku-inthanethi.

en.title: Nobody's ready to listen yet
en.body: We need two people who speak this language to hear your clip before it counts. Check back later to see the result.

zu.title: Akekho oselungele ukulalela
zu.body: Sidinga abantu ababili abakhuluma lolu limi ukuthi balalele isiqeshana sakho ngaphambi kokuba sibalwe. Buya kamuva uzobona umphumela.

en.title: Still waiting to be heard
en.body: Nobody's confirmed this one yet. If two people don't hear it in time, we'll tell you honestly rather than leave it hanging.

zu.title: Kusalindwe ukuthi kuzwakale
zu.body: Akekho osekuqinisekisile lokhu okwamanje. Uma abantu ababili bengakuzwa ngesikhathi, sizokutshela iqiniso kunokuba sikushiye ulindile.

en.title: Your consent is off
en.body: You've turned this off, so you can't play right now. Any reward you already earned is still yours. Turn it back on any time to keep going.

zu.title: Imvume yakho ivaliwe
zu.body: Uyivalile imvume, ngakho awukwazi ukudlala manje. Umvuzo osuwuzuzile usengowakho. Ungayivula noma nini ukuze uqhubeke.

en.title: No rounds right now
en.body: This language's rounds are paused for the moment. Check back later for the next round.

zu.title: Akukho mizuliswano okwamanje
zu.body: Imizuliswano yalolu limi imisiwe okwamanje. Buya kamuva ngomzuliswano olandelayo.

en.title: Payments are running on our test system right now
en.body: Everything else still works exactly the same. This is clearly marked so nobody is confused about what's real.

zu.title: Izinkokhelo zisebenza ohlelweni lokuhlola okwamanje
zu.body: Konke okunye kusasebenza ngendlela efanayo. Lokhu kuboniswe ngokucacile ukuze kungabikho odidekayo ngokuthi yini engokoqobo.

en.title: That payout didn't go through
en.body: Nothing was lost — your balance is unchanged. Try again later when payments are available.

zu.title: Lokho kukhokhwa akuhambanga
zu.body: Akukho okulahlekile — ibhalansi yakho ayikashintshi. Zama futhi kamuva lapho izinkokhelo sezitholakala.

en.title: Already done
en.body: That already happened, so nothing changed the second time. No extra reward, no extra charge.

zu.title: Sevele kwenziwe
zu.body: Lokho sekuvele kwenzekile, ngakho akukho okushintshile okwesibili. Akukho mvuzo owengeziwe, akukho mali eyengeziwe ekhokhiswayo.
